Bundled CJK font sources and copyrights

M PLUS 1p ExtraBold: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/mplus1p
Noto Sans CJK JP/SC/TC Black: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk

WOFF2 files preserve the original glyph outlines and full character coverage.
CSS family names StageJP/StageJPFallback/StageSC/StageTC are application aliases.
